newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil firmer, tighter supplies firm barges.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil firmer, tighter supplies firm barges.

text.p: NWE gas oil prices were firmer on Tuesday with tightening ARA supplies firming barge and steadying cargo premiums to firmer benchmark gas oil futures, traders said.
Brokers said prompt barge supplies were becoming fairly tight and although end-user demand was balanced trade house short-covering had boosted premiums by around 50 cents.
However, early trade was thin with the small contango between July and August futures encouraging sellers to raise offers.
Prompt barges were bid at July IPE +$1 with offers at +$1.50 a tonne fob Rotterdam with Flushing barges on offer at July IPE +75 cents to +$1 fob.

The market for second half July barge liftings was also slightly firmer but brokers said buyers and sellers were at stand-off with buyers at July IPE +50 cents finding sellers asking August IPE +$1 per tonne fob ARA.
Diesel barges were traded at a steady July IPE +$5 a tonne and were later talked around July IPE +$5/+$5.50 fob ARA.
Diesel cargoes were not so stable though with prompt deliveries valued around 50 cents softer at July IPE +$4 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
0.2 sulphur cargo differentials were steady around July IPE +$1/+3 a tonne with a cargo for second decade July reported offered into Germany at around August IPE +$2 a tonne.
